title: Mean of the mod-two inner-product bit
statement: For every nonnegative integer $m$, choose uniformly a vector $z\in\mathbb{F}_2^{2m}$ and split it into two blocks $u,v\in\mathbb{F}_2^m$. The average of the indicator that the dot product $u\cdot v$ is $1$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$ is $\frac{1-2^{-m}}{2}$.
